ImageDescription.value:
I do like interesting imports like this one. Most I see are those JDM minivans. This is a North American model second generation Ford Focus 4 door sedan, built in Wayne, Michigan USA in 2008. It was imported here in 2010. There can't be an awful lot of these over here- interesting the owner's gone to the trouble of shipping it all the way over, rather than just buying a car here. Not sure if I prefer the look of this or the standard UK Ford Focus.
